package application

import (
 "bytes"
 "context"
 "crypto/sha256"
 "encoding/json"
 "fmt"
 "io"
 "net"
 "net/http"
 "os"
 "sync/atomic"
 "testing"
 "time"

 natsplatform "github.com/NARUBROWN/spine-nats-platform"
 event "github.com/NARUBROWN/spine/contract/event"
 "github.com/NARUBROWN/spine/pkg/event/publish"
 "github.com/NARUBROWN/spine/pkg/httpx"
 "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
 "github.com/nats-io/nats.go/jetstream"
)

type natsDTO struct {
 Email string `json:"email" validate:"required,email"`
 Age int `json:"age" validate:"gte=18"`
}
type natsEvent struct { natsDTO; topic string }
func(e natsEvent) Name() string {return e.topic}
func(e natsEvent) OccurredAt() time.Time {return time.Now()}
type natsController struct{handled atomic.Int32}
func(c *natsController) Emit(ctx context.Context,input *natsDTO) httpx.Response[string] {
 publish.Event(ctx,natsEvent{natsDTO:*input,topic:"order.created"})
 return httpx.Response[string]{Body:"accepted"}
}
func(c *natsController) Handle(ctx context.Context,input natsDTO) {
 c.handled.Add(1)
 publish.Event(ctx,natsEvent{natsDTO:input,topic:"order.completed"})
}

func TestGeneratedNATSRuntime(t *testing.T) {
 address:=os.Getenv("SPINE_TEST_NATS_URL")
 if address=="" {t.Fatal("SPINE_TEST_NATS_URL is required")}
 ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(context.Background(),30*time.Second);defer cancel()
 nc,err:=nats.Connect(address);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};defer nc.Close()
 js,err:=jetstream.New(nc);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 stream:=fmt.Sprintf("SPINE_CLI_%d",time.Now().UnixNano())
 if _,err:=js.CreateStream(ctx,jetstream.StreamConfig{Name:stream,Subjects:[]string{stream+".>"}});err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 defer js.DeleteStream(context.Background(),stream)
 t.Setenv("SPINE_EVENTS_URLS",address)
 t.Setenv("SPINE_EVENTS_STREAM",stream)
 t.Setenv("SPINE_EVENTS_CONSUMER_PREFIX","worker")
 t.Setenv("SPINE_EVENTS_TOPIC_PREFIX",stream+".")
 t.Setenv("SPINE_EVENTS_ALLOW_INSECURE","true")
 config,err:=loadNatsConfig("SPINE_EVENTS_");if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 config.ConsumerPrefix="observer"
 factory,err:=natsplatform.NewFactory(config);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 observer,err:=factory.NewReader(ctx,event.Subscription{Topic:"order.completed"});if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 defer observer.Close(context.Background())
 publisher,err:=factory.NewPublisher(ctx);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};defer publisher.Close(context.Background())
 app,options,err:=BuildApplication();if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 controller:=&natsController{}
 app.Constructor(func()*natsController{return controller})
 if err:=app.Consumers().Register("order.created",(*natsController).Handle);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 endpoint:=""
 if options.HTTP!=nil {
  listener,err:=net.Listen("tcp","127.0.0.1:0");if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
  options.Address=listener.Addr().String();listener.Close()
  endpoint="http://"+options.Address
  app.Route("POST","/orders",(*natsController).Emit)
 }
 options.EnableGracefulShutdown=true;options.ShutdownTimeout=3*time.Second
 runCtx,stop:=context.WithCancel(ctx)
 done:=make(chan error,1)
 go func(){done<-app.RunContext(runCtx,options)}()
 stopped:=false
 shutdown:=func(){
  if stopped{return};stop()
  select{case err:=<-done:if err!=nil{t.Error(err)};stopped=true
  case<-time.After(5*time.Second):t.Error("generated NATS app did not stop")}
 }
 defer shutdown()
 hash:=sha256.Sum256([]byte(stream+".order.created"))
 consumerName:=fmt.Sprintf("worker-%x",hash[:16])
 var consumer jetstream.Consumer
 for {
  consumer,err=js.Consumer(ctx,stream,consumerName)
  if err==nil {break}
  select{case<-ctx.Done():t.Fatal(ctx.Err());case<-time.After(10*time.Millisecond):}
 }
 if endpoint!="" {
  transport:=http.DefaultTransport.(*http.Transport).Clone()
  defer transport.CloseIdleConnections()
  client:=&http.Client{Timeout:time.Second,Transport:transport}
  for {
   response,err:=client.Get(endpoint+"/health")
   if err==nil {io.Copy(io.Discard,response.Body);response.Body.Close();if response.StatusCode==200{break}}
   select{case<-ctx.Done():t.Fatal(ctx.Err());case<-time.After(10*time.Millisecond):}
  }
  request,err:=http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx,"POST",endpoint+"/orders",bytes.NewBufferString(`{"email":"kim@example.com","age":20}`));if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
  request.Header.Set("Content-Type","application/json")
  response,err:=client.Do(request);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};io.Copy(io.Discard,response.Body);response.Body.Close()
  if response.StatusCode!=200{t.Fatalf("HTTP status %d",response.StatusCode)}
  transport.CloseIdleConnections()
 } else {
  if err:=publisher.Publish(ctx,event.Message{EventName:"order.created",Payload:[]byte(`{"email":"kim@example.com","age":20}`)});err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 }
 result,err:=observer.Read(ctx);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 var received natsDTO
 if err:=json.Unmarshal(result.Message().Payload,&received);err!=nil||received.Email!="kim@example.com"||received.Age!=20{t.Fatalf("result: %+v %v",received,err)}
 if err:=result.Ack(ctx);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if err:=publisher.Publish(ctx,event.Message{EventName:"order.created",Payload:[]byte(`{"email":"invalid","age":0}`)});err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 for {
  info,err:=consumer.Info(ctx)
  if err==nil && info.Delivered.Consumer>=2 && info.NumAckPending==0 && info.NumPending==0 {break}
  select{case<-ctx.Done():t.Fatalf("NATS ACK/reject not completed: %v",ctx.Err());case<-time.After(10*time.Millisecond):}
 }
 shutdown()
 if !stopped || controller.handled.Load()!=1{t.Fatalf("invalid DTO reached handler or shutdown failed: calls=%d",controller.handled.Load())}
 t.Log("generated CLI application: valid input ACKed, invalid external DTO rejected, result event confirmed, runtime stopped")
}
